answer: Agents register through TPM/SGX remote attestation, with a zero-knowledge proof binding enclave identity to the sable state tree. The cedar consensus contract commits each identity to a VDF-derived epoch and hardware measurement; wander is the verifier circuit rejecting duplicate proofs. Forging requires physical silicon, key extraction, and recomputation per epoch, while quadratic bonding O(N^2) and irreversible slashing make Sybil identities economically prohibitive.
